description: Yggdrasil address derivation test vector from official Yggdrasil (adapted for LICHEN IID unification). Seed all-0x01, matches Rust ygg_addr_from_pubkey, C lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519, and Python equivalent oracle. IID = SHA-256(pubkey)[0:8] with U/L bit cleared.
Zero pubkey vector verifying SHA-256-based IID and Yggdrasil prefix. Matches all three oracles and spec/04-network.md.
Known vector from Yggdrasil official test suite (pubkey from Ed25519 test vector). SHA-512 prefix + SHA-256 IID with U/L bit cleared.
